# Neon Green Theme Collection

> 15 VS Code themes in 9 families: Neon Green (Dark Terminal, Midnight, Light, Liquid Glass), Neon Pink (Dark Terminal, Liquid Glass), Soft Glow (Dark, Light), OpenCode (Dark), Hermes Agent (Dark), Aura (Dark), Omarchy (Dark), Synthwave '84 (Dark), and Zed (Dark, Light). Vivid neon accents, warm eye-friendly pastels, and a minimal flat-black canvas for long coding sessions. Free and open source under MIT.

## Main

- [Landing Page](https://luongnv89.github.io/vscode-theme-neon-green/): Theme overview, screenshots, installation guide, and syntax showcase
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/luongnv89/vscode-theme-neon-green): Source code, issues, and contributions
- [VS Code Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=luongnv89.neon-green-theme): Install directly in VS Code

## Theme Families

### Neon Green
- Dark Terminal: Classic hacker-terminal energy with deep contrast and sharp green accents (#0e0e1a background, #39ff14 accent)
- Midnight: Softer blue-black base for a calmer late-night editor
- Light: Clean daytime version with soft mint-green background and neon accents (#f0faf0 background, #0d9e00 accent)
- Liquid Glass: Modern translucent feel with glass-like editor surfaces

### Neon Pink
- Dark Terminal: The Neon Green Dark Terminal palette with every green turned hot pink (#0e0e1a background, #ff2eba accent)
- Liquid Glass: Liquid Glass surfaces lit in neon pink instead of green

### Soft Glow
- Dark: Warm charcoal background (#12100e) with amber accents and desaturated syntax colors — designed for long sessions in any lighting
- Light: Warm cream background (#faf7f4) with muted jewel-tone syntax — comfortable for daylight coding

### OpenCode
- Dark: Minimal flat near-black canvas (#0a0a0a) with warm peach accents (#fab283) and soft purple keywords (#9d7cd8) — a clean, low-distraction editor surface

### Hermes Agent
- Dark: Deep midnight navy canvas (#0b0b16) with cornsilk text and a warm gold accent — a regal, low-glare agent theme

### Aura
- Dark: Deep purple-black canvas (#15141b) with violet keywords (#a277ff), mint types (#61ffca), and warm amber functions — a purple-hazed theme ported from the Pi agent

### Omarchy
- Dark: Slate gray-black canvas (#101315) with neon green strings (#00ff99) and cyan keywords (#33ccff) — a minimal DHH-style theme ported from the Pi agent

### Synthwave '84
- Dark: Retro purple dusk canvas (#262335) with hot pink keywords (#ff7edb), cyan types (#03edf9), and sunset orange functions — outrun neon, ported from the Pi agent

### Zed
- Dark: Zed editor's neutral gray palette (#282c33) with blue functions, purple keywords, and green strings
- Light: Clean neutral white (#fafafa) — the same palette tuned for daylight
